title: AWS CLI credentials and config
whyItMatters: AWS access keys and session settings in this folder can be used to act as the account owner against cloud resources.
notes: Covers credentials and config plus any cached SSO tokens in subfolders. File contents are not read.

cleanup.signOut: Delete or deactivate the access keys this PC used in the AWS Identity and Access Management console, so the stored keys stop working.
steps: Revoke the access keys in the AWS console.
Delete the folder named in the plan.
Check the AWS console again that no key from this machine is still active.
cleanup.risk: Removes the AWS profiles from this PC. Keys that are not deleted in AWS keep working from any other machine, so revoke them first.
cleanup.source: AWS, Configuration and credential file settings: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cli/latest/userguide/cli-configure-files.html
